1.description: [Pending Restart] [Darkmoon] [Dawnrise] - A new Talent/Mystic Enchant is now available! [Sacred Conduction]: Direct or periodic Holy Fire damage grants Sacred Conduction, increasing Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning damage by 5% per stack for 10 seconds, up to 15 stacks. Gaining stacks does not refresh the duration.

[Pending Restart] [Darkmoon] [Dawnrise] - A new Talent/Mystic Enchant is now available! [Faith in the Elements]: Dealing damage with Smite extends your Flame Shock on the target by 2 seconds and reduces Lava Burst's remaining cooldown by 1 second.

0.description: [Going Live Monday, 3 August] [Darkmoon] - The % damage bonuses from Unending Fury, Answered Prayers, Enhanced Weapon Mastery, and Blessed Weapons no longer stack with each other.

[Going Live Monday, 3 August] [Darkmoon] [Dawnrise] - Fixed an issue where certain proc effects could be triggered by abilities that are not on the global cooldown, including On-Next-Hit replacement abilities such as Cleave, Raptor Strike, Maul and Heroic Strike. This fix resolves several problematic interactions and restores intended proc behaviour.

1.description: [Pending Restart] [Darkmoon] [Dawnrise] - Light of Dawn's base healing has been increased at all levels.
[Pending Restart] [Darkmoon] [Dawnrise] - Fixed a bug preventing Divine Star from functioning correctly. Its base healing has been significantly increased at all levels.
[Pending Restart] [Darkmoon] [Dawnrise] - Fixed a bug causing Phoenix Egg’s healing to not scale with Healing Power and increased its base healing at all levels.
[Pending Restart] [Darkmoon] [Dawnrise] - Loa's Assault now cost 10 rage, down from 30.

0.description: Fixed a bug that caused creatures in Open World to scale too hard.
Premades for Battlegrounds are now capped at 3 people on Darkmoon and Dawnrise
Fixed crazy creature scaling on the Iskarr Village Level 19 of Manastorm

raised global experience for all content Open World, PvP, Dungeons, etc by 15%. Reduced Experience gain from level 1 manastorms by 20%, then increased experience gain from each higher level manastorms to encourage doing higher levels. This is intended to move closer towards different ways to level all being very viable.

[Pending Restart] [Darkmoon] [Dawnrise] - [Divine Concord]: In addition to making your next Arcane Blast instant, consuming The Art of War with Arcane Blast grants one additional Arcane Blast stack or Harnessed Energy charge.

[Pending Restart] [Darkmoon] [Dawnrise] - A new Talent/Mystic Enchant is now available! [Mystical Pursuit]: Arcane Missiles damage grants up to 5 charges. While charged, Seal of Arcane Wrath also triggers an off-hand hit.
[Pending Restart] [Darkmoon] [Dawnrise] - Fixed a bug causing Penance to consume all stacks of Spirit Frost.
[Pending Restart] [Darkmoon] [Dawnrise] - Icecrown Double Tap’s proc chance has been increased to 25%, up from 15%.

[Pending Restart] [Darkmoon] [Dawnrise] - Improved Barkskin now increases Armor by 30%/60%, reduced from 80%/160% to account for the higher Armor values available from Classless cloth and leather gear.
[Pending Restart] [Darkmoon] [Dawnrise] - Holy abilities can now also trigger Holy Shatter, in addition to Holy Spells.
[Pending Restart] [Darkmoon] [Dawnrise] - Counterattack's scaling has been increased by 300%. It now scales from Attack Power instead of Ranged Attack Power.
[Pending Restart] [Darkmoon] [Dawnrise] - Mongoose Bite's scaling has been increased by 200%. It now scales from Attack Power instead of Ranged Attack Power.
[Pending Restart] [Darkmoon] [Dawnrise] - Black Widow Poison now deals Plague damage, combining Shadow and Nature damage.
[Pending Restart] [Darkmoon] [Dawnrise] - Armor of Wrath now reduces damage taken by 12% for 6 seconds, up from 2%.

[Pending Restart] [Darkmoon] [Dawnrise] - A new Talent/Mystic Enchant is now available! [Judged Infection]: Dealing damage with a Judgement increases damage taken from your Blood Plague by 20% for 15 seconds.
[Pending Restart] [Darkmoon] [Dawnrise] - A new Talent/Mystic Enchant is now available! [Vengeful Plague]: While Seal of Vengeance is active, your Blood Plague deals 50% increased damage.

[Pending Restart] [Darkmoon] [Dawnrise] - A new Talent/Mystic Enchant is now available! [Righteous Opportunity]: Dealing direct damage with spells and abilities has a 15% chance to allow one use of Hammer of Wrath regardless of the target's health.
[Pending Restart] [Darkmoon] [Dawnrise] - Fixed a bug causing Spot Weakness to have a 100% proc chance; it now has its intended 15% proc chance.
[Pending Restart] [Darkmoon] [Dawnrise] - A new Talent/Mystic Enchant is now available! [Darkwing Volley]: Black Arrow and Black Widow Poison reduce Summon Gargoyle's remaining cooldown by 3 seconds.

[Pending Restart] [Darkmoon] [Dawnrise] - A new Talent/Mystic Enchant is now available! [Scourging Instinct]: Mongoose Bite and Raptor Strike have a 20% chance to make your next Scourge Strike consume no runes and deal double Shadow damage.

[Pending Restart] [Darkmoon] [Dawnrise] - A new Talent/Mystic Enchant is now available! [Pestilent Reprisal]: Obliterate causes your next Counterattack to deal 15% increased damage for each of your diseases on the target.

[Pending Restart] [Darkmoon] [Dawnrise] - A new Talent/Mystic Enchant is now available! [Permafrost Wound]: Deep Freeze causes the target to bleed for Froststrike damage every 3 seconds for 15 seconds. Mongoose Bite and Raptor Strike extend the bleed by 1 second.
[Pending Restart] [Darkmoon] [Dawnrise] - A new Talent/Mystic Enchant is now available! [Frozen Reflexes]: Consuming Fingers of Frost with Mongoose Bite resets Mongoose Bite's cooldown.

[Pending Restart] [Darkmoon] [Dawnrise] - A new Talent/Mystic Enchant is now available! [Exorcist's Bite]: Dealing damage with Exorcism temporarily increases the damage share inherited by Deadly Bite by 50%.

[Pending Restart] [Darkmoon] [Dawnrise] - A new Talent/Mystic Enchant is now available! [Divine Ferocity]: Mongoose Bite and Counterattack increase the damage of your next Divine Storm by 20% per stack, up to 5 stacks.

[Pending Restart] [Darkmoon] [Dawnrise] - A new Talent/Mystic Enchant is now available! [Judged Retaliation]: Your Judgements have a 50% chance to reset Counterattack's cooldown and allow it to be used without requirements.
Fixed a bug where Path of Duality was not increasing your Ranged Attack Power.
[Blood Presence] - Blood Presence now heals for 2% of all damage dealt implicitly. The capstone for Improved Blood Presence still improves this value to 5%.
[Dawnrise] Reduced Rune and Gold cost to unlearn abilities and talents by 50%.
[Darkmoon] Starter Skillcards are now available on character creation from the beginning rather than after prestige, so you can simply slot your starters.
All abilities mentioned above will come with class point reductions to create more build flexibility.
